scope: Present exterior of the heritage buildings on the old north campus of Tianjin Nankai High School: Boling East Building, North Building, Fansun Building, Ruiting Auditorium and the two mapped Xizhai dormitory rows. Excludes later classroom blocks, interiors and other campuses.

review.notes: The local Qualla article and its matched candidates were checked first. Contemporary exterior photography was excluded, and no underlying first edition or publication was verified for the old East Building exterior. The classroom and group portraits do not document the architecture. No historical or modern reference image was adopted.
